_comment: REDIRECT TARGETS THAT DO NOT RESOLVE.
The 301 map in content/url-map.md proposed routes during Phase 0, before the
slugs and the information architecture settled. Any target that does not
resolve is tracked here with a reason and a closing move, and
tests/redirects.spec.ts asserts that the dead set is EXACTLY this set — an
existing gap cannot be forgotten, and a new one cannot appear unnoticed.
ALL FIFTEEN ARE NOW CLOSED (T-299). None of them was closed by building a
route to satisfy the map; every one was repointed at a page that already
exists and already carries the content:
5 x per-villa and per-estate /gallery sub-pages -> the villa or estate page,
which carries that property's own photographs.
4 x /en/amenities/* -> the estate page or the location page. Per-amenity
pages were never built; the amenities live in the inventories.
5 x experience slug drift -> the inventory's own slug
(organic-farm -> biological-garden, private-boat-trip -> boat-trip,
private-chef -> chef-in-villa, dream-wedding -> dream-weadding,
water-sports -> jet-ski-safari).
1 x /en/thalasses-rituals -> /en/weddings. THIS ONE WAS A LOOP, not a 404:
the path was both a source and a target, so it pointed at itself. A 404
loses a page; a loop hangs the browser. D1a moved the venue to the
Weddings route, so the URL follows the content.
ONE OWNER QUESTION SURVIVES THE CLOSURE, and it is not a gap because the
redirect now resolves — it is a question about whether it resolves to the
RIGHT page. It has moved to the owner-pending list in SESSION-REPORT.md:
/en/jet-ski-safari-1.html was titled 'Water Sports' on the legacy site and
there is no combined water-sports page in the inventory. It now lands on
/en/experiences/jet-ski-safari, which is the nearest real thing. If the
legacy page covered more than jet skis, the destination should change.
Eight rows remain UNINSTALLABLE rather than dead, and are reported by
`npm run redirects` on every run: three are fragment sources (a server
redirect cannot see a #hash) and five are template rows describing a pattern
rather than a literal path. Both classes are covered by LAUNCH.md §2.
